description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseMessage' used as a foundation for API request messages in the 'Microsoft.eShopWeb.PublicApi' namespace. It manages a unique correlation ID for logging purposes.

classes.name: BaseMessage
classes.description: An abstract class serving as the base for API message requests, providing a unique correlation ID for logging.

methods.name: CorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the GUID used as the correlation ID for the message.
